d: Fatima sets a plan in motion to get back at Hayden  Zac and Fatima travel into uncomfortable territory with Karen, putting their relationship to the test.
Maurice reaches out to Calvin and is reassured that all will be well  Zac plans for a talk with Karen and Fatima when Andi shows up.
Zac makes Karen an offer that she can definitely refuse  Fatima is finally forced to come clean, and she and Karen face off at the townhouse while Andy and Zac are present.
Zac is blindsided when Fatima's friend catches him in a questionable situation  Tamara has Hayden right where she needs him  gathering pertinent information for Fatima.
Fatima confronts Zac with proof of an inappropriate interaction  Maurice must come up with bail in order to get out of jail.
Fatima's accusations push Zac over the edge  Danni settles in her decision with Preston  Andi possibly finds her way into becoming a partner.
Karen and Andi deal with a matter of betrayal that threatens the sisterhood  Fatima leaves Zac for the night to make hard decisions about what her next move should be.
Sabrina makes a surprising discovery while at Danni's apartment  Fatima puts Zac in his place as they continue to argue over harsh words.
